dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hello. Can I speak to Fah, please?
dialogue.reading: həˈloʊ. kən aɪ ˈspiːk tə ˈfɑː, ˈpliːz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Just a moment… Sorry, she's not here. Who's calling?
dialogue.reading: ˈdʒʌst ə ˈmoʊmənt… ˈsɑːri, ʃiːz ˈnɑːt ˈhɪr. ˈhuːz ˈkɔːlɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: This is Mr. Smith, her English teacher.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɪs ɪz ˈmɪstər ˈsmɪθ, hɜːr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˌtiːtʃər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, hello, Mr. Smith. She's at the library now.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, həˈloʊ, ˈmɪstər ˈsmɪθ. ʃiːz ət ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: OK. Can you call me back at five?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. kən juː ˈkɔːl miː ˈbæk ət ˈfaɪv?
